# 🚀 One-Click GitHub App Creation

## Step 1: Click this URL (everything is pre-filled!)

**https://github.com/settings/apps/new?**

## Step 2: Click "Create" on the GitHub page

## Step 3: Copy the App ID and download the Private Key

## Step 4: Install the App on your repository

## Step 5: Run the automation

```bash
cd hok-ai-system
cp .env.example .env
# Edit .env with your App ID and Installation ID
pip install -r requirements.txt
python app.py
```
